content.description: We are building a development framework for zero-knowledge smart contracts with very short proving times and built-in automatic formal verification. This innovative solution allows for significantly faster and cheaper transactions while maintaining the high level of security and decentralization that Cardano is known for. Our Team Vladimir Sinyakov Founder & Solution Architect 4+ years delivering blockchain projects across Bitcoin, Ethereum, and Cardano. Ph.D. in mathematics, space industry background. As the solution architect behind every zkFold-led project, Vladimir has designed and delivered systems spanning wallet infrastructure, cross-chain bridges, privacy protocols, ZK circuit programming frameworks, and L2 scaling solutions.
